title: Identification of key hub genes associated with anti-gastric cancer effects of lotus plumule based on machine learning algorithms.
authors: Meng, Fan-Di; Jia, Shu-Min; Ma, Yu-Bin; Du, Yu-Hua; Liu, Wen-Jing; Yang, Yi; Yuan, Ling; Nan, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于机器学习识别莲子心抗胃癌关键基因，虽涉及转录因子和分子对接，但核心是疾病基因筛选而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Lotus plumule and its active components have demonstrated inhibitory effects on gastric cancer (GC). However, the molecular mechanism of lotus plumule against GC remains unclear and requires further investigation. AIM: To identify the key hub genes associated with the anti-GC effects of lotus plumule. METHODS: This study investigated the potential targets of traditional Chinese medicine for inhibiting GC using weighted gene co-expression network analysis and bioinformatics. Initially, the active components and targets of the lotus plumule and the differentially expressed genes associated with GC were identified. Subsequently, a protein-protein interaction network was constructed to elucidate the interactions between drug targets and disease-related genes, facilitating the identification of hub genes within the network. The clinical significance of these hub genes was evaluated, and their upstream transcription factors and downstream targets were identified. The binding ability of a hub gene with its downstream targets was verified using molecular docking technology. Finally, molecular docking was performed to evaluate the binding affinity between the active ingredients of lotus plumule and the hub gene. RESULTS: This study identified 26 genes closely associated with GC. Machine learning analysis and external validation narrowed the list to four genes: Aldo-keto reductase family 1 member B10, fructose-bisphosphatase 1, protein arginine methyltransferase 1, and carbonic anhydrase 9. These genes indicated a strong correlation with anti-GC activity. CONCLUSION: Lotus plumule exhibits anti-GC effects. This study identified four hub genes with potential as novel targets for diagnosing and treating GC, providing innovative perspectives for its clinical management.
abstract_zh: 背景：莲子心及其活性成分已被证实对胃癌（GC）具有抑制作用。然而，莲子心抗胃癌的分子机制尚不明确，需进一步研究。目的：识别与莲子心抗胃癌作用相关的关键枢纽基因。方法：本研究利用加权基因共表达网络分析和生物信息学方法，探讨中药抑制胃癌的潜在靶点。首先，鉴定了莲子心的活性成分和靶点，以及与胃癌相关的差异表达基因。随后，构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，以阐明药物靶点与疾病相关基因之间的相互作用，促进网络中枢纽基因的识别。评估了这些枢纽基因的临床意义，并鉴定了其上游转录因子和下游靶点。利用分子对接技术验证了枢纽基因与其下游靶点的结合能力。最后，通过分子对接评估了莲子心活性成分与枢纽基因之间的结合亲和力。结果：本研究识别出26个与胃癌密切相关的基因。通过机器学习分析和外部验证，将列表缩小至四个基因：醛酮还原酶家族1成员B10、果糖-二磷酸酶1、蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶1和碳酸酐酶9。这些基因显示出与抗胃癌活性的强相关性。结论：莲子心具有抗胃癌作用。本研究识别出四个枢纽基因，有望成为诊断和治疗胃癌的新靶点，为其临床管理提供了创新视角。
